_comment: Plan B1 (docs/plans/2026-10-27-sicherheitskette/PLAN-B1-sandbox-run.md), B1.5 (PLAN-B15-deps.md) and B2 (PLAN-B2-build.md). Read only from the INSTALLED plugin directory, never from the checkout under review. An image is accepted only if `docker image inspect` reports exactly this id. Change it in a reviewed commit after a human built the image from config/sandbox/python-test.Dockerfile (and config/sandbox/codex-build.Dockerfile on top of it). Ids recorded 2026-11-01 (python-test:3 with cryptography 50.0.2; codex-build:1 with codex-cli 0.162.1).

python-test._tools_comment: argv[0] must be one of these (plan Approach 4: only image-contained dependencies; anything else is refused with the B1.5 explanation).
python-test._deps_comment: Plan B1.5 (PLAN-B15-deps.md step 3). wheel_target: the tags a wheel may carry to be handed in with --deps. The image is Debian 13 with glibc 2.41 (measured 2026-11-01: platform.libc_ver() -> ('glibc', '2.41'); pip debug lists manylinux_2_41 down; re-measured on python-test:3 2026-11-01, unchanged), CPython 3.13, amd64. All five deps_* keys or none; an image without them refuses --deps.

codex-build._comment: Plan B2 approach 1: FROM claudex-sandbox-python-test:3 (the id pinned above) plus the Codex npm tarball @openai/codex@0.162.1-linux-x64 (ADD --checksum sha256:7417711678b464eee70664126e39e88bb3c84c2928da0e71f14b56e04ff5c09f) under /opt/codex/, codex on PATH, CODEX_HOME=/codex-home. tools = python-test's list plus codex; the five deps keys are python-test's values, written out explicitly (same base, same interpreter and glibc).

build._comment: Plan B2 approach 2 (measurement 2026-11-01, PLAN-B2-REVIEW-LOG.md 'Step 0 measurements, proxy design'). Validated as strictly as deps_policy(); a missing or malformed section refuses every build. On chatgpt.com every method, path or query other than `forward` and `local` is answered 404 locally, a websocket upgrade 403; the `local` route is answered with the fixed routing response of measurement (d) carrying the PLACEHOLDER account id. Sizes are bytes.
build._generated_paths_comment: Added paths matching these are excluded and reported, never published; a changed baseline path is never excluded. Glob relative to the repository root, `**` = any number of segments.
build._probe_comment: Sample ports: common service ports, the Docker API ports, the Docker Desktop host-service port 18765 seen on 192.168.65.254 and the VM listener 44837 found open on a non-isolated gateway (measurement 2026-11-01). Never 3128, where the proxy listens. Budget with these values: 6 x 8 (the /29 minus probe and proxy) + 2 x (8 + at most 16 published) + 8 (169.254.169.254) + 6 (IPv6 literal, 1.1.1.1:443, 8.8.8.8:53, three names) = 110 <= max_targets.
